prompt: A web administrator working on a Debian-based system notices that the default service name for the Apache web server seems different than what he used on a CentOS system. Which of the following represents the default service names for Apache on Debian-based and CentOS systems, respectively?
explanation: On Debian-based systems the Apache service is named `apache2`, while on CentOS (and other Red Hat-based systems) it is named `httpd`.
